sources.title: opt-2.7b: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: OPT-2.7B is a 2.7 billion parameter decoder-only language model developed by facebook and released in May 2022. It belongs to the Open Pre-trained Transformer family, which ranges from 125M to 175B parameters, designed to match the performance of GPT-3-class models while applying best practices in data collection and efficient training.

sources.title: Post-Training LLMs Guide: SFT, RLHF, DPO & GRPO Explained (2026)
sources.snippet: The transformation from a base model to a product-grade AI system happens during post-training, and the techniques involved - SFT, DPO, RLHF, GRPO, Constitutional AI - represent one of the most dynamic and consequential areas of applied AI research.
